scope: The source family is the 18 combinations of put mode (ignore/replace/upsert), channel (changes/total/both), and trigger presence. Calibration receipts pin the combination; the goal is predicted only when all consistent members agree.
lesson: INSERT OR IGNORE reports changes()=0 on conflict, REPLACE and upsert report 1. total_changes accumulates per connection; the both channel sums main and other. A trigger adds one log row but does not change changes()/total_changes for the direct statement.
